title: Add live malformed stdout coverage for agent runtime
summary: Make malformed agent stdout a distinct runtime failure mode and cover it with an opt-in live subprocess test that executes a fixture agent emitting invalid JSON with exit code 0.
expectedFailureModes: A successful agent process emits malformed stdout and the runtime reports a generic serde failure with no boundary context.
The daemon records a successful dispatch when the agent result was not valid JSON.
The malformed-output test accidentally depends on external services or default CI live execution.
Runtime diagnostics leak raw agent stdout beyond the minimal parse error context.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant-runtime --test live_malformed_stdout --locked -- --ignored live_
humanEscalation: Approval before making live tests part of default CI
nextAction: Integrated locally; next runtime live slice should assert daemon-level dispatch failure receipts after that operator-facing shape is formalized.
